verdict.rationale: The Colorado SOS business-entity data is published as open datasets on the state portal: data.colorado.gov advertises business entities, DBAs, tax and UCC filing data, and the SOS business page links an 'Intelligence Center - Business data' section. A hands-on keyless GET to the business-entities dataset returned JSON, so the data is machine-readable without scraping. Missing for 10: documented bulk file exports (e.g. CSV) and refresh cadence, verified access to the UCC, DBA and other registries beyond the one probed dataset, and first-party docs describing the extracts in depth.
